basic_info.description: Discover turnkey SoMa loft living in this tastefully remodeled 1BD/2BA condo offering exceptional space, a terrace and parking just one block from Mission Bay amenities. Inside, double-height ceilings soar above with designer lighting and rows of oversized windows. Relax and entertain in the sprawling great room featuring a gas fireplace and an adjacent terrace. Chefs will adore the beautifully updated open kitchen, where glass cabinetry, granite counters and subway tile backsplashes surround a fleet of Samsung black stainless steel appliances. An oversized utility room with a stacked washer-dryer and generous storage completes the main floor. Head upstairs to explore the carpeted owner's suite loft, featuring a king-size sleeping area, an oversized walk-in closet, and an en suite bathroom with an open vanity and separate water closet/wet room rain shower. A deeded parking space with storage and EV-ready wiring completes this move-in ready SoMa showplace. Contemporary building with Butterfly MX intercom entry. One block from all Mission Bay amenities, waterfront outdoor space, Oracle and Chase stadiums, UCSF, shopping, freeways and transportation. Including Caltrain, and new T-Line to Chinatown, North Beach and MB.
